column1: # Measure gates for cpl_ibm2 (validation-manifest contract: measures).
# Why measures: the v(v3) crosstalk trace peaks near 0.56 mV, and
# ngspice-46's own peak moves -38 to -43 percent when tmax is halved or
# quartered (the 2010 reference itself is one sample of that family);
# RSpice's peak sits inside the band at -24 percent. Pointwise sub-mV
# samples there gate solver-grid reproduction, not coupling physics --
# the CPL kernel's coupling is exercised by the driven-line gates and
# the peak envelope below. The driven line v(v1) carries tight timing
# Source: VES pulses 0->1 V at t=0 (1.5 ns edges), falls 6.0-7.5 ns.
# v(v1) = driven line far end (~0.67 V scale); v(v3) = victim-line
